name: MonarchTheme
title: Theme
summary: Installs a Monarch theme (colours, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, motion) in the SwiftUI environment and sets the tint.
whenToUse: Once, at the root of the app or of a screen that uses Monarch. Apply it again lower in the tree to give a subtree another scheme or accent.
whenNotToUse: Do not read MonarchTokens colours directly in views; read the theme from the environment so the view follows Dark Mode, Increase Contrast and the accent.
api: func monarchTheme(scheme: MonarchSchemePreference = .system, contrast: MonarchContrastPreference = .system, accent: MonarchAccent = MonarchTokens.Accents.rook, ai: MonarchAccent? = nil, typography: MonarchTypography = .system) -> some View
func monarchTheme(_ appearance: MonarchAppearance, typography: MonarchTypography = .system) -> some View

options.name: scheme
options.description: Light, dark or the device setting.

options.name: contrast
options.description: Standard, high contrast or the Increase Contrast setting.

options.name: typography
options.description: Optional custom font families. The system typeface by default.

states.name: light
states.description: Standard contrast on a light canvas.

states.name: dark
states.description: Standard contrast on a dark canvas.

states.name: hc-light
states.description: High contrast on a light canvas; focus ring 3 points wide in the text colour.

states.name: hc-dark
states.description: High contrast on a dark canvas; focus ring 3 points wide in the text colour.

appearance: Resolves to one of four themes. The accent replaces the accent roles, links, and (in the standard themes only) the focus ring. A custom AI colour (withAI, from MonarchBrandTheme.aiAccent) replaces the AI roles, thinking and citation.
platformNotes: Android wraps MaterialTheme and the web sets CSS custom properties; iOS puts a value in the SwiftUI environment and sets tint, so system controls take the accent without Monarch wrapping them. Only the subtree is themed: sheets and system chrome presented outside it follow the device.
accessibility: Follows Dark Mode unless a scheme is fixed.
Switches to the high-contrast themes when Increase Contrast is on, unless a contrast is fixed.
The high-contrast themes draw the focus ring 3 points wide in the text colour.
edgeCases: A component used outside monarchTheme() gets the light theme with the default accent.
Applying the modifier again inside a themed tree replaces the theme for that subtree only.
A custom font family that is not registered with the app falls back to the system font.

examples.title: Fix the scheme, contrast and accent
Read the theme in a view
Apply a custom AI colour
examples.code:
Text("Summarised by AI")
    .environment(
        \.monarchTheme,
        MonarchTheme(tokens: ai.map(theme.tokens.withAI) ?? theme.tokens, typography: theme.typography)
    )
examples.setup:
@Environment(\.monarchTheme) private var theme
private let ai = MonarchBrandTheme.derive(brand: "#0A7CFF", ai: "#7C3AED").aiAccent
